faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Technician post at IIT Madras is 24th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technician position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an MSc in Chemistry, Physics, Material Science, or Nanoscience, or a BE/B.Tech in Instrumentation and Material Science with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in TEM operation/maintenance is required for the Project Technician position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technician post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technician post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Technician role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves online application, shortlisting, a test/interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technician is on a contract basis.
